business_summary: Lontrue Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the agricultural and sideline product processing activities in China and internationally. The company offers fresh fruits, nuts, seeds, dried fruits, kernels, and prepackaged products, as well as OEM services and data center, computer room testing, and data center architectural design services. In addition, the company's primary products include raisins, fresh apples, pine nuts, and pine nut kernels. The company serves the food, IDC, and logistics industries. It is also involved in the exporting activities. The company was formerly known as Yantai Guangyuan Fruit Vegetable Co., Ltd and changed its name to Lontrue Co., Ltd. in May 2009. Lontrue Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Longkou, China.
